content.comment_body: This did not resolve my issue; the application crashes immediately on startup. I only see the [company_name] logo banner briefly before it closes. There was no 'god mode' folder present, so I created and removed it, but that didn't change anything. I also updated and reinstalled Java, but the problem remains and it continues to crash.

analysis.insight_summary: A user encounters a crash immediately at software startup, with only the [company_name] logo displayed before the application closes. Despite following common troubleshooting steps (creating/removing a specific folder and updating/reinstalling Java), the startup issue persists. There is no indication that the problem was resolved, highlighting a lack of clear support resources or self-help documentation for startup crashes.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the application to launch consistently and to have access to effective troubleshooting options or support when encountering startup crashes.
